mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "AUTH_ATTEMPT_BUCKET" ("BUCKET_TYPE", "BUCKET_KEY", "WINDOW_START_AT", "ATTEMPTS", "EXPIRES_AT") VALUES ('REQUEST', #{digest}, TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00', 0, 'infinity') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO "AUTH_USER_GUARD" ("USER_ID", "UPDATED_AT") VALUES (#{userId}, to_timestamp(#{now} / 1000.0)) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN "BLOCKED" THEN coalesce("OPERATION_ID"::text, 'BLOCKED') ELSE '' END FROM "AUTH_USER_GUARD" WHERE "USER_ID" = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT "LOGIN_ID"::text AS "SID", "USER_ID" , (extract(epoch FROM "CREATED_AT") * 1000)::bigint AS "CREATED_AT" , (extract(epoch FROM "AUTHENTICATED_AT") * 1000)::bigint AS "AUTHENTICATED_AT" , (extract(epoch FROM "LAST_ACTIVITY_AT") * 1000)::bigint AS "LAST_ACTIVITY_AT" , (extract(epoch FROM "IDLE_EXPIRES_AT") * 1000)::bigint AS "IDLE_EXPIRES_AT" , (extract(epoch FROM "ABSOLUTE_EXPIRES_AT") * 1000)::bigint AS "ABSOLUTE_EXPIRES_AT" , (extract(epoch FROM "REVOKED_AT") * 1000)::bigint AS "REVOKED_AT" , "REVOKE_REASON", "PERMISSIONS_JSON"::text AS "PERMISSIONS_JSON", "CURRENT_REFRESH_HASH" FROM "AUTH_LOGIN" WHERE "LOGIN_ID" = #{sid}::uuid
SELECT count(*) FROM "AUTH_LOGIN" WHERE "USER_ID" = #{userId} AND "REVOKED_AT" IS NULL AND "IDLE_EXPIRES_AT" > to_timestamp(#{now} / 1000.0) AND "ABSOLUTE_EXPIRES_AT" > to_timestamp(#{now} / 1000.0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "AUTH_LOGIN" ("LOGIN_ID", "USER_ID", "CREATED_AT", "AUTHENTICATED_AT" , "LAST_ACTIVITY_AT", "IDLE_EXPIRES_AT", "ABSOLUTE_EXPIRES_AT", "PERMISSIONS_JSON", "CURRENT_REFRESH_HASH") VALUES (#{sid}::uuid, #{userId}, to_timestamp(#{createdAt} / 1000.0) , to_timestamp(#{authenticatedAt} / 1000.0), to_timestamp(#{lastActivityAt} / 1000.0) , to_timestamp(#{idleExpiresAt} / 1000.0), to_timestamp(#{absoluteExpiresAt} / 1000.0) , #{permissionsJson}::jsonb, #{currentRefreshHash})
mapper.update: UPDATE "AUTH_LOGIN" SET "LAST_ACTIVITY_AT" = greatest("LAST_ACTIVITY_AT", to_timestamp(#{now} / 1000.0)) , "IDLE_EXPIRES_AT" = least("ABSOLUTE_EXPIRES_AT", greatest("IDLE_EXPIRES_AT", to_timestamp((#{now} + #{idleMillis}) / 1000.0))) WHERE "LOGIN_ID" = #{sid}::uuid AND "REVOKED_AT" IS NULL AND "IDLE_EXPIRES_AT" > to_timestamp(#{now} / 1000.0) AND "ABSOLUTE_EXPIRES_AT" > to_timestamp(#{now} / 1000.0)
UPDATE "AUTH_LOGIN" SET "REVOKED_AT" = to_timestamp(#{now} / 1000.0), "REVOKE_REASON" = #{reason} WHERE "LOGIN_ID" = #{sid}::uuid AND "REVOKED_AT" IS NULL
UPDATE "AUTH_LOGIN" SET "REVOKED_AT" = to_timestamp(#{now} / 1000.0), "REVOKE_REASON" = #{reason} WHERE "USER_ID" = #{userId} AND "REVOKED_AT" IS NULL
mapper.select: INSERT INTO "AUTH_ATTEMPT_BUCKET" ("BUCKET_TYPE", "BUCKET_KEY", "WINDOW_START_AT", "ATTEMPTS", "BLOCKED_UNTIL", "EXPIRES_AT") VALUES (#{type}, #{hash}, to_timestamp((#{now} - mod(#{now}, #{window})) / 1000.0), 1 , CASE WHEN #{maximum} = 1 THEN to_timestamp((#{now} + #{lock}) / 1000.0) END , to_timestamp((#{now} - mod(#{now}, #{window}) + #{window} + #{lock}) / 1000.0)) ON CONFLICT ("BUCKET_TYPE", "BUCKET_KEY", "WINDOW_START_AT") DO UPDATE SET "ATTEMPTS" = "AUTH_ATTEMPT_BUCKET"."ATTEMPTS" + 1 , "BLOCKED_UNTIL" = CASE WHEN "AUTH_ATTEMPT_BUCKET"."ATTEMPTS" + 1 = #{maximum} THEN to_timestamp((#{now} + #{lock}) / 1000.0) ELSE "AUTH_ATTEMPT_BUCKET"."BLOCKED_UNTIL" END RETURNING CASE WHEN "ATTEMPTS" > #{maximum} THEN greatest(1, ceil(extract(epoch FROM ("EXPIRES_AT" - to_timestamp(#{now} / 1000.0))))::bigint) ELSE 0 END
SELECT greatest(0, ceil(extract(epoch FROM (max("BLOCKED_UNTIL") - to_timestamp(#{now} / 1000.0)))))::bigint FROM "AUTH_ATTEMPT_BUCKET" WHERE "BUCKET_TYPE" = 'ACCOUNT' AND "BUCKET_KEY" = #{hash}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM "AUTH_LOGIN" WHERE "LOGIN_ID" IN (SELECT "LOGIN_ID" FROM "AUTH_LOGIN" WHERE "ABSOLUTE_EXPIRES_AT" <= to_timestamp(#{now} / 1000.0) LIMIT 1000 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)

DELETE FROM "AUTH_ATTEMPT_BUCKET" WHERE ("BUCKET_TYPE", "BUCKET_KEY", "WINDOW_START_AT") IN (SELECT "BUCKET_TYPE", "BUCKET_KEY", "WINDOW_START_AT" FROM "AUTH_ATTEMPT_BUCKET" WHERE "EXPIRES_AT" <= to_timestamp(#{now} / 1000.0) LIMIT 1000 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
